scope: computed topology operation counts; runtime profiling loaded only if source file exists

window.state: Install latest topology before 290 s into a fresh processor; vibration state starts at rest.

runtimeProfile.method: Unmodified SurfacePlateProcessor source executed in a Chrome main-realm AudioWorkletProcessor stub. Each case uses one untimed warmup plus three clean measured 10-second replays, then a separate CDP sampling replay. Events are dispatched at exact scheduled frame boundaries.
runtimeProfile.attribution: V8 samples report function/source locations for process, advancePhysics, computeLap, advanceNodules and other called worklet code. Contact dispatch is timed separately. Intra-Plate recurrence, Z-link loops and pickup/output mixing are inline within advancePhysics, so their sampled cost cannot be separated without changing the profiled source.
runtimeProfile.limitation: Main-realm CPU profile and processor wall time are not AudioWorklet deadline, realtime, or underrun measurements. Rest initialization omits pre-290 s vibration history. Schedule files contain compiled topology payloads, so source topology compilation time is unavailable; structured-clone cost is reported separately as a transfer proxy.
